worstCaseMethod: Largest additive combined article-plus-exact-keb-remainder evidence costs within each disjoint D/E eligibility class. Shared family records are overcounted for a selection-independent upper bound. Actual extensions deduplicate.

limits: Forecast is not a guarantee. Actual long-context identity, no compaction and the pre-phase-2 actual-token plus selected-article/dictionary capacity gate remain mandatory.

memory.additionalChecks: Before each file and each streamed chunk; signal interruption on a sampled breach.
